claims.claim: The Farum progression proceeds from Crumbling Beast Grave Depths to Tempest-Facing Balcony, then Dragon Temple and Dragon Temple Transept before Godskin Duo.

After Godskin Duo, Dragon Temple Altar is the post-boss grace; the main route continues through Dragon Temple Rooftop to Beside the Great Bridge, while Dragon Temple Lift is an optional Stonesword Key branch.
From Beside the Great Bridge, the optional Placidusax route descends to floating ruins and uses the Lie Down prompt to trigger a one-way transition to the time-lost arena.

notes: The main and optional Farum layers are represented separately; the Placidusax time transition is not treated as a normal walkable edge.
No game process, save, archive, memory or original XYZ coordinate was accessed.
